model_hash_scope: model_sha256 hashes original input MJCF bytes before in-memory visual stripping, terrain augmentation and configuration; terrain_runtime_audit verifies actual compiled geometry after configuration
observation_normalization: included inside TorchScript actor; no second normalizer

contract.domain_randomization: disabled during evaluation; nominal fixed parameters
contract.actuator_limits_provenance: project sim2sim baseline settings; NOT verified manufacturer hardware ratings

task_profile.description: Matched S/T support-duration costs;fixed independent-camber reference and3D wheel-axis reward;explicit original K warm start.

trained_task_profile.description: Matched S/T support-duration costs;fixed independent-camber reference and3D wheel-axis reward;explicit original K warm start.

training_domain_randomization.source: mjlab v1.4.0 tracking events adapted to TRON1
training_domain_randomization.push_timer_reset_correction: resample all interval timers at episode reset; do not reproduce v1.4 function-event reset bug

evaluation_contact_friction_override.meaning: target effective pair coefficient; native material mapping, not contact-law equivalence

contact_material_audit.combination_note: Both contacting materials have the same value; max/average combination agree.
contact_material_audit.mapping: explicit wheel priority1 / other colliders0; all colliding sliding mu equal target; not mu squared

native_plant_readback.source: compiled native MuJoCo MjModel arrays after declared configuration
native_plant_readback.inertia_convention: body_inertia principal moments; body_ipos/body_iquat define local inertial frame

domain_parameter_implementation: scaled DC motor envelope, then smooth wheel axle drag, then nominal net-effort guard

contact.force_source: summed wheel-ground normal contact forces, excluding robot self-contact

contact_slip_measurement.point_source: MuJoCo data.contact.pos for wheel/world collision pairs only
contact_slip_measurement.velocity_source: mj_jacBodyCom at data.xipos; COM linear and angular velocity transported to each contact point
contact_slip_measurement.lateral_axis: body local +Y wheel axle projected into each actual contact tangent plane
contact_slip_measurement.aggregation: normal-force-weighted RMS over active contact points per wheel
contact_slip_measurement.no_contact: count=0 and slip=0; slip requires positive contact count for interpretation
contact_slip_measurement.ground_force_kind: sum of normal contact forces, matching the filtered PhysX contact API

nonwheel_ground_contact_force_kind: sum of actual wheel-excluded ground contact normal forces; point count uses normal force >1N
limitations: One deterministic sim2sim episode, not a robustness or real-hardware validation.
Contact solver/cylinder approximations and self-collision parent filtering remain engine-specific.
DC no-load speed defines a torque-speed envelope, not a hard qvel limit; external forces can exceed it.
DC motor parameters are simulation assumptions, not validated manufacturer ratings. The DC model changes training physics.
MuJoCo contact forces are instantaneous constraint forces; Isaac contact sensors may aggregate differently.
Lateral contact slip uses real contact points sampled at 400 Hz; contact patch resolution remains engine-specific.
Reference is held for each 20 ms action; training termination predicates are checked before phase advances.
